field_survey_policy.missing_data_rule: Retain missing in observed mode; use only the registered central/low/high image or remote-sensing proxy for the sensitivity arm.

comparison_conditions.EXISTING: Computable no-intervention baseline evaluated on all five outcomes from the shared frozen world model; not a generated workflow.
comparison_conditions.CONVENTIONAL: Fixed rule-order GIS/parametric template with one-pass review and no multi-agent arbitration.
comparison_conditions.DIGITAL: Deterministic standalone GIS/simulation/parametric workflow with fixed seed and no multi-agent arbitration.
comparison_conditions.POLIS: Provenance-aware multi-agent workflow with conflict, equity, local-feedback, and orchestration layers.

population.missing_rule: No equal-weight or other population imputation is permitted.

chicago_boundary.operation: 20 m planar buffer around the axis in EPSG:26916
chicago_boundary.basis: The author manuscript specifies the selected local segment plus a 20 m envelope.
chicago_boundary.legal_status: Analytical boundary only; not a parcel, ownership, or legal right-of-way assertion.

resource_constraint.formula: resource_index = 100 * sum(allocated_area_fraction_d * resource_weight_d) / sum(resource_weight_d); budget_ratio = resource_index / scenario_cap_units
resource_constraint.interpretation: Unitless controlled resource constraint; not capital cost, procurement estimate, or maintenance budget.

regulatory_scoring.active_rule: Score a regulatory predicate only when its registered analytical trigger condition has frozen scenario evidence.
regulatory_scoring.missing_trigger_rule: Record not_evaluable and exclude from the score denominator; never code pass or not_applicable by assumption.
regulatory_scoring.implementation_claim: Analytical screening only; no project-level permit or compliance claim is made.
